title: Billing dispute over unexpected $65 roaming surcharge
summary: Customer questioning sudden increase from regular $77.50 to $142.50 due to Swiss international data charges.

messages.content: Why on earth is my bill $142.50 this month?? My regular bill has always been $77.50 for my Fiber 100 and Ultra Mobile plan! I have not changed my subscription at all.
There is an extra $65 charge on my invoice. I was in Zurich for 2 days for business and was told Europe was included. I am not paying this unexpected fee until someone explains this and fixes it.
